english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for being afraid of something or expecting something bad with alarm.
Use this for being afraid or for saying that someone is easily frightened, rather than for causing the fear.
Use this when “tremble” means to fear or be afraid, rather than to shake physically.

examples.english: I fear he won't make it home.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ging1 keoi5 wui5 faan1 m4 dou2 uk1 kei2

examples.english: I scare easily, so I don't watch horror films.
examples.traditional: 我好易驚，所以唔睇恐怖片。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 ji6 ging1 so2 ji5 m4 tai2 hung2 bou3 pin2

examples.english: I tremble with fear as soon as I see the snake.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 tiu4 se4 zau6 ging1
